final_review_correction: receipt-destination-gate-correction.json records the final source/test hashes and scoped verification after restoring the frozen >=2GiB/W_OK destination gate. The source hashes below identify the preserved original three-test receipt snapshot.

API.host_preflight: mint_host_attestation(fresh_run/field, fresh_run/probe/ownership.json, profile=authenticated_profile, mode='fixture' or 'production') records actual Windows SID, ACL and file IDs for both fresh exact leaves and their parent.
API.factory: ReceiptBridge(root, receipt_dir, marker_path, marker_sha256, *, profile, attestation_path, attestation_sha256, cancelled=None)
API.core_callback: Inject bridge.write_output directly: write_output(raw, features, coords, provenance, output, *, profile). output must be this bridge's exact receipt_dir.
API.host_poller: bridge.host_receipt().poll() performs real independent host verification and publishes the acknowledgement only after successful readback and unchanged host ownership/file identities.
API.leaf_names: Reuse the frozen owner's exact sibling field/probe guard unchanged. field contains the two payload files; probe contains only the attempt's receipt/control files.
API.marker: Fixtures require a separate cpu-only-attempt.marker binding mode, profile hash and canonical artifact root; the unused neural-attempt.marker stays absent. A marker never authorizes inference.

protocol.writer: Original exact ownership preflight and actual field writer/readback, exclusive durable artifact-ready.json, wait for independent host-artifact-verified.json, then exact marker/path/profile/contract/attestation/metadata/artifact hash and size checks before returning independently_verified_before_release=True.
protocol.host: Read bounded plain single-link ready receipt, authenticate its exact identities, check real Windows SID/ACL/file IDs before read, run the actual independent profile-authenticated field reader, check both field/control roots and output file identities again, then exclusively publish a durable matching PASS acknowledgement.
protocol.provenance: The artifact itself binds ownership_attestation_sha256 and receipt_marker_sha256; ready/ACK also bind the profile, run contract, paths, artifact hash/bytes and complete metadata hash.
protocol.ownership: The original field capability class and checks remain unchanged and never authorize receipt filenames. Control-file reads preserve exact known paths, plain/single-link/filesystem/parent ownership, bounds and identity checks under the separately host-attested probe leaf. A future WSL worker must still pass the genuine canonical factory's live UID/mount/root checks for both attested roots; no fake credential or UID exception exists.
protocol.future_root: A separately approved future run must mint a fresh Windows-owner-attested brick field/probe pair. The old fixed turret leaf, old attestation and old fixed-root owner helper are not reused.

qualification.TDD: The initial focused test failed because receipts did not exist. Actual Windows qualification then correctly refused Python TemporaryDirectory's special OWNER RIGHTS ACL. Tests now exclusively create normal inherited-ACL directories with mkdir; no ACL was changed and no ownership check was relaxed. All three actual protocol tests pass.
